name: CommonBadge
desc:
A small UI component to display status, counts, or categories.
Supports optional icons and granular style control to match specific UI designs.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: CommonCard
desc: A unified card component for project details, skill blocks, or profile sections.

name: CommonChip
desc:
A compact UI element that represents an attribute, text, or entity.
Supports selection and deletion.

name: CommonDialog
desc:
Centralized utility for showing various types of dialogs.
Uses specific Route references to manage singleton dialogs reliably.

name: showConfirm
desc: Shows a confirmation dialog with OK and Cancel buttons.

name: showCustom
desc: Shows a custom content dialog with a title and optional actions.

name: showMessage
desc: Shows an informational dialog with a single button.

name: showSwitchDialog
desc: Shows a list of selection options with checkmarks.

name: DialogSwitchItem
desc: Data model for a selection item within a dialog.

name: CommonDivider
desc:
A unified divider component that supports both horizontal and vertical orientations
with consistent theme-based styling and optional padding.

name: CommonEmptyView
desc:
A professional empty state placeholder widget.
Used when a list is empty, search fails, or an error occurs.

name: EmptyType
desc: Preset types for the empty view to quickly configure common scenarios.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: CommonImage
desc: A unified image component supporting assets, network (with caching), disk files, SVG, and optimized GIFs.

name: memCacheWidth
desc: Limits the decoded image size in memory to prevent crashes with large images.

name: CommonInkWell
desc:
A universal wrapper that adds Material ripple effects to any widget.
Integrated with HapticFeedback for a better tactile experience.

name: useHaptic
desc: Whether to trigger a light haptic feedback on tap.

name: CommonListItem
desc:
A standard list item component with a leading icon, title, subtitle, and trailing widget.
Commonly used for settings, menus, or simple data lists.

name: CommonLoading
desc: A global loading indicator widget managed via Overlay.

name: hide
desc: Removes the current loading overlay.

name: isShow
desc: Returns true if the loading overlay is currently visible.

name: show
desc: Displays a modal loading overlay.

name: CommonRefreshList
desc:
A flexible wrapper that supports pull-to-refresh functionality for both lists and single children.
Integrated with CommonEmptyView to handle empty states automatically.

name: child
desc: Optional single child. If provided, items will be ignored.

name: itemBuilder
desc: Builder for list items. Required if items is provided.

name: items
desc: Optional list of items. If provided, renders as a ListView.

name: onRefresh
desc: The async callback triggered when pulling down.

name: showEmptyView
desc: Whether to show the empty view when items is empty.

name: CommonSkeleton
desc: A professional skeleton loader widget to provide better visual feedback during loading.

name: CommonSkeleton.circle
desc: Factory for a circular skeleton (e.g., Avatars).

name: CommonSkeleton.line
desc: Factory for a typical line of text.

name: CommonSkeletonListTile
desc: A helper widget to build a skeleton list item (ListTile style).

name: CommonSwitch
desc:
A common switch component that provides a consistent look and feel across the app.
It wraps the CupertinoSwitch for a clean, modern aesthetic while respecting the app's theme.

name: activeTrackColor
desc: The color to use for the track when this switch is on. Defaults to the theme's icon or primary color.

name: inactiveTrackColor
desc: The color to use for the track when the switch is off.

name: onChanged
desc: Called when the user toggles the switch on or off.

name: scale
desc: The scale factor for the switch size. Defaults to 0.8 to fit better in dense lists.

name: value
desc: Whether this switch is on or off.

name: CommonTextField
desc:
A reusable text input component based on TextFormField.
Supports password toggling, input limiting, and centralized styling.

name: accentColor
desc: The color to use for icons and focus. If null, uses the theme's primary color or icon color.

name: controller
desc: Controls the text being edited

name: errorText
desc: Text that appears below the field when validation fails

name: hintText
desc: Text that suggests what sort of input the field accepts

name: isDigitsOnly
desc: If true, restricts input to numeric characters only

name: keyboardType
desc: Manually override the keyboard layout (e.g., phone, url)

name: labelText
desc: Text that describes the input field (floats when focused)

name: maxLength
desc: Maximum number of characters allowed

name: onChanged
desc: Callback when the text value changes

name: prefixIcon
desc: Icon to display at the beginning of the text field

name: textInputAction
desc: The type of action button to show on the keyboard

name: type
desc: The logical type of the field (affects keyboard and obscure logic)

name: validator
desc: Function to validate the input text

name: TextFieldType
desc: Predefined styles for common input scenarios

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: CommonToast
desc: A global toast utility managed via Overlay.

name: hide
desc: Manually hides the toast.

name: show
desc: Displays a brief toast message.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: UIKitConfig
desc:
Global configuration for UIKit components to avoid hardcoded strings
and support internationalization through injection.

name: getString
desc:
Retrieves a string for the given key.
It tries the provider first, then falls back to defaults.

name: init
desc:
Initializes the UIKit configuration.
stringProvider A function that takes a key and returns a translated string.
